mapper.sql: user_id, notify_report_ready, notify_study_due, notify_interview, notify_import_failure, notify_ai_failure, timezone_id, audit_retention_days, notification_retention_days, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_preference(user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_preference WHERE audit_retention_days IS NOT NULL OR notification_retention_days IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user_preference SET notify_report_ready = #{record.notifyReportReady}, notify_study_due = #{record.notifyStudyDue}, notify_interview = #{record.notifyInterview}, notify_import_failure = #{record.notifyImportFailure}, notify_ai_failure = #{record.notifyAiFailure}, timezone_id = #{record.timezoneId}, audit_retention_days = #{record.auditRetentionDays}, notification_retention_days = #{record.notificationRetentionDays}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{record.updatedAt} WHERE user_id = #{record.userId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
